subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation options for renewal/PO
body:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + attestation question for upcoming renewal/PO

Hi Kimberly,

We’re getting close to our renewal and procurement approval window. The legal team asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the period through 2027-12-31, plus any available interim attestation or bridge language you can provide that covers Jan–Apr 2028 while the next audit is in progress.

Can you confirm:
- Do you have the final Type II report for the 2027 period?
- Will Redwood provide a bridge letter or interim attestation that explicitly states coverage for Q1 2028?
- If so, what’s the typical timeline to get a signed interim attestation (DocuSign) once we confirm the PO?

We need that language to get procurement comfortable with the contract start date; our buyer needs a PO approved by 5/10.

Thanks,
Emma
Enterprise Procurement
Acme Health

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + attestation question for upcoming renewal/PO

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we have the completed SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2027-12-31, and we can provide an interim attestation/bridge letter that covers a limited post-report window (we typically cover up to the start of the next audit period).

Details and next steps:
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (full report) and an interim_attestation_template.docx (standard wording we use).
- Coverage: Our standard bridge attestation references the last completed Type II and confirms controls have not materially changed as of the attestation date; it usually covers the 3–4 month window until the next audit engagement begins.
- Timing: Once you confirm the PO and the attestation scope, we can route the attestation for executive sign-off and DocuSign. Typical turnaround is 2–3 business days for signature after we receive the PO and any required customer-specific language.
- Evidence: if procurement needs additional artifacts (e.g., evidence index, control descriptions, or SOC control mappings), Marissa can share the evidence bundle link and a short matrix for your security team.

Action items for Acme:
1) Confirm whether your legal needs the standard interim wording or requires specific boilerplate to be added.
2) Share the PO target date (you mentioned 5/10) and the billing start date you need documented.

Marissa — looping you in to confirm evidence access and whether we need to escalate to Legal for any non-standard attestation language.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + attestation question for upcoming renewal/PO

Thanks, Kimberly.

We’d like the standard interim wording unless Legal flags anything. PO target is 2028-05-10 and the desired service start date is 2028-06-01. Procurement asked if the attestation can explicitly reference service start date and PO number — they prefer the interim to say it bridges through 2028-06-15 to give a buffer. Is that feasible?

I’ll share a redlined PO if that helps.

—Emma

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acmehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + attestation question for upcoming renewal/PO

Hi Emma — I work on the compliance evidence packs and attestation workflow. Quick notes:

- We can reference the PO number and a concrete service start date in the interim attestation, provided the PO is final and the start date is accurate. For coverage through 2028-06-15 that aligns with our standard 45-day buffer; happy to commit to that in writing.
- I uploaded the evidence index and control mapping (read-only) to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDEFghSOC2 (see Related Links). The index lists sample artifacts and the control owners; it’s redacted for customer sensitivity but suitable for procurement/legal review.
- DocuSign workflow: once you confirm PO and the exact text for the attestation, I’ll prepare the attestation on our DocuSign template and route for exec signature. Expect sign-off in 1–3 business days in most cases.
- If Legal requests additional artifact access, we can open a time-bound evidence portal (S3 presigned bundle) — let me know the point of contact.

Attachment: interim_attestation_template.docx (contains the language we typically use).

Ben — flagging for visibility on PO timing and any commercial notes.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Jacob Lee <j.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 May 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + attestation question for upcoming renewal/PO

Kimberly/Marissa — thanks for the quick responses and materials. Attaching the PO draft and procurement_po_template.pdf with the expected PO number (ACME-PO-5542).

We’re good to proceed with your standard interim attestation wording adjusted to bridge through 2028-06-15 and to reference ACME-PO-5542. Please send the DocuSign envelope when ready; procurement will queue approval as soon as the attestation is attached to the PO.

Jacob Lee
Senior Buyer, Acme Health
Attachment: acme_po_draft.pdf

---
[Thread notes]
- Attachments referenced in thread: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (full report), interim_attestation_template.docx (attestation wording), procurement_po_template.pdf (customer PO template), acme_po_draft.pdf (customer-supplied PO draft).
- Docs stored to shared drive for evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDEFghSOC2
- Expected next steps: Redwood (Marissa) prepares DocuSign attestation, references ACME-PO-5542, route for executive signature, then deliver signed attestation to Acme procurement and attach to PO.
